task: explain predicted mean tumor fraction, not diagnostic classification
source: PyG GNNExplainer implementation of Ying et al. 2019
mask: object nodes and edges, joint optimization; default regularizers
deletion: zero normalized features (training mean); topology unchanged
eligible: all nodes including partially annotated nodes; output averaged over original valid nodes
metric: absolute change from original regional prediction; signed change also saved
data: eight existing BCSS patients with out-of-training checkpoints
heldout_status: two previously examined patients, not a new untouched test
selection: all patients, all seeds, fixed budgets; no result-driven tuning
